explanation: Erdős #1044 (Erdős–Herzog–Piranian): determine the infimum of Λ(f), the maximal boundary length of components of {|f| < 1}, over monic f with all roots in the closed unit disc. The site records Tang's resolution: the infimum is 2. The Lean takes the IsGLB of the set of Λ(f) values (length = 1-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the frontier), with answer 2. The statement is correct and solved.
